messages:
lina-partnerships: FYI, GPUNode (hardware partner) flagged a hold: their procurement team won't accept PO until we sign an export-control addendum. apparently customs/classification info missing on our side.

evan-procurement: we received the email at 09:03 PT. PO 98765 stuck in queue. supplier says they need ECCN and end-user declaration attached to the PO for cross-border shipments.

matt-hw-partner: confirming. our global ops can't clear shipments to APAC without the ECCN and the customer's end-use cert. standard for this SKU.

olga-legal: quick note: we don't currently have an export addendum in our MSA. we can do a short addendum that references EAR guidance and requires customers to provide end-use certificates. i'll draft.

steph-sales: this is blocking a demo and two committed deals in APAC. partner wants an ETA; customers are asking if shipment will be delayed w/o docs.

evan-procurement: on our side, we can hold the PO approval and not send funds, but we need the legal text and a checklist for required attachables so ops can validate. otherwise we'll keep rejecting uploads.

olga-legal: action: i'll author a 1-page addendum + checklist. questions for HW partner: do you require a specific ECCN format or just the classification string?

matt-hw-partner: we accept ECCN as a free-text code (e.g., 5A992.c) plus the country-specific routing notes. also need consignee's business registration and a signed end-user statement.

lina-partnerships: thanks. procurement, legal: can we do a temporary workaround so POs can be ingested with a 'pending-docs' status rather than rejected? that would let the partner progress internal workflows while docs are gathered.

evan-procurement: temporarily changing platform behavior is doable but risky. if we allow 'pending-docs' it must prevent dispatch and finance must not create invoices. also need audit flag. we can implement as a pipeline status change.

olga-legal: legal ok with a 'pending-docs' staging flag provided the addendum is attached before shipment and the partner acknowledges liability.

steph-sales: can we promise partners a timeline? if legal drafts addendum today, procurement can update status by EOD, and partner can upload documents within 48 hours. ok?

matt-hw-partner: that's workable. we'll send template end-user cert to customers and can validate quickly. appreciate the 'pending' option.

deploy-bot: infra note: feature-flag "po.pending_docs_status" created. rollout plan: enable for partnerships namespace on staging at 18:00 UTC for validation.

evan-procurement: plan: procurement will block dispatch for any PO with status != approved; we'll add a filter to the fulfillment queue. ETA for filter change: 12 hours after staging validation.

olga-legal: i'll drop the addendum draft into the legal drive and link here. it will include required doc list: ECCN, end-user cert, consignee registration, and export classification attestation.

lina-partnerships: please ping me when draft is ready so i can notify HW partner and coordinate a joint comms to customers.

steph-sales: i'll prepare a short customer message template and coordinate with partner ops for instructions.

matt-hw-partner: thank you. once the staging flag is live and legal text is in place we'll start accepting POs into 'pending' and push customers to upload docs.

lina-partnerships: great work team. next steps: olga to post addendum draft (by 14:00 PT), deploy-bot to post staging link when flag is enabled, evan to gate dispatch and confirm queue filters. will update partner after staging pass. :white_check_mark:
